title: Quadrupeds, What They Are and Where Found: A Book of Zoology for Boys
sourceTitle: Quadrupeds, What They Are and Where Found: A Book of Zoology for Boys
author: Mayne Reid
description: "Quadrupeds, What They Are and Where Found: A Book of Zoology for Boys" by Mayne Reid is a scientific publication aimed at educating young readers about various four-legged animals around the world, likely written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This engaging work explores the different species of quadrupeds, categorizing them by families and habitats while avoiding overly technical jargon to suit its youthful audience.

authorInfo.bio: Mayne Reid (1818–1883) wrote Quadrupeds, What They Are and Where Found: A Book of Zoology for Boys. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
